newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Patterson Dental EPS view.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Patterson Dental EPS view.

text.p: -- Everen Securities Inc said Friday it raised its fiscal 1997 earnings estimate to $1.52 a share from $1.48, and increased its fiscal 1998 estimate to $1.78 a share from $1.72.
-- On Thursday, Patterson Dental previewed third quarter to January 25 earnings in the range of $0.41 to $0.42 a share, which would be above consensus.
-- Everen also raised its six-month price target for the stock to $34 a share from $31, and its 18-month target to $39 from $35.
-- Patterson Dental shares were up 1/4 at 29-1/2.
